text: Aplikace mi přijde uživatelsky velmi přívětivá, bohužel v ní nefungují žádná oznámení. V telefonu Samsung A 53 5G jsem všechna oznámení povolil a nic se nestalo. Pokud by se tento problém vyřešil, tak by to byla skvělá apka.
author: Jiří Krčál

text: Love the interface, design, and functionality (except the pop up window where you can uncheck which tasks you have missed, that one needs some rework). Only habit app so far that works for me
author: Lukáš Žák

text: Awesome app, more settings for sounds or animations would be welcome.
author: Martin Lexa

text: Thanks to this app, living my life is like playing a game. Doing healthy and productive stuffs is now easier and my bad habits are under control as I am using them as an reward for doing good habits. Super easy to use. Love it.
author: Jiří Jirsák

text: This app is amazing, I fall in love at the first sight! Yes, it has pro version, but it is only 85 CZK for lifetime. Thank you developers.
author: Slečna P.
